name: Fishers Island (Raynor's headland in Long Island Sound)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Fishers Island Club, from the developer's photos (release assorted-lidar-data, fishers.1-6) and the NYS orthophoto: bright, saturated fairways and greens; tawny-gold fescue rough with a rust tint beyond a mown band; dark thickets of bayberry and shadbush (woods ground G0-G2); cream-white sand; grey shore boulders; deep blue Sound. Out of bounds (L0-L2) is the island's tawny meadow. Trees in assets-src/trees_fishers_island.py: red cedar, pitch pine, wind-pruned oak, bayberry thickets. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
